source_snapshot.items: LC.3_LC Tray Leak - Disconnect Sensor Fault
source_snapshot.procedure: Physically unplug the leak detection sensor from the board.
source_snapshot.criteria: The tray detects a sensor fault and sends the correct BMC signals.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60/60 minutes; unique generic-HW code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO/MANUAL; correctly assigns disconnect to a person but omits connector identity, safe operating state, exact diagnostics and reconnection recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; retained Pending for connector/power/coolant map, BMC fault contract and safe reseat.

old_problem: The required physical open-circuit stimulus lacks connector designators, powered-versus-isolated access rules, coolant/pump/valve state, ESD handling, exact tray/BMC fault IDs and latency, and an approved reconnect/fault-clear recovery oracle.
disposition_reason: Pending remains because the exact connector and whether it may be unplugged energized are core hardware safety semantics, while the expected diagnostic/BMC identifiers and recovery are authoritative PASS criteria. ED-09 keeps the action MANUAL ONLY; ED-15/16/20 prohibit guessing the hardware map or accepting a generic alarm. The procedure is otherwise fully drafted for one qualified disconnect and controlled restoration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2096, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2097 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00019-V002 / 488d7ba191536b5a was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
This is the generic HW variant; the following GB-NV-PVP connector map and evidence cannot satisfy it without explicit equivalence approval.
The test covers real electrical-continuity supervision, so software injection or a pre-existing SEL entry cannot substitute for the physical connector-open state.
Qualified personnel must verify tray, board, sensor, harness and connector designators plus latch/pin condition before touching hardware.
The owner must specify power, coolant pressure/flow, pump/valve and access state; energized disconnect is prohibited unless explicitly designed and approved.
Capture physical photos and full unfiltered tray/Redfish/SEL assertion timing before reseat; after approved reseat inspect pins/latch and prove fault deassertion plus restored protection.
Perform one disconnect only and stop on wrong identity, liquid, heat, arcing, damage, unexpected cooling/power action or failed clear.
No connector manipulation, power/coolant action, BMC query, reseat, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: HW tray physical leak-sensor open-circuit diagnosis — PROCEDURE PENDING
test_case.purpose: Under an approved hardware access state, open the designated tray leak-sensor circuit once, prove the exact tray/BMC fault response, then safely reseat and verify protection is fully restored.
required_package: Signed tray/board/sensor/harness/connector designators and service instructions
Approved power, coolant pressure/flow, pump, valve and interlock state
Qualified operator, ESD controls and connector/latch handling tools
Exact local diagnostic plus Redfish/SEL IDs, polarity and assertion/deassertion limits
Reseat inspection, fault-clear and return-to-service recovery criteria
test_case.test_command: NO REMOTE EXECUTION COMMAND. Do not touch the connector until identity and safe state are signed. Qualified personnel capture baseline photos/state/logs, establish the approved power/coolant/ESD condition, and after point approval unplug only the mapped sensor connector once by its latch without pulling wires. Timestamp physical open, local fault and complete BMC events. Preserve evidence, then under separate approval inspect/reseat the connector and prove fault clear and restored protection. Do not use software simulation or repeat.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the connector/fault contract is signed. The single physical open must assert the specified tray sensor-fault and exact BMC signals within limits without unsafe collateral action; approved reseat must clear the fault and restore connector integrity and leak protection.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while connector, safe state, signal/timing and recovery are undefined. After unlock, PASS requires immutable physical identity, one controlled open, complete local/BMC assertion evidence, intact hardware, approved reseat, timely deassertion and restored protection. FAIL on wrong connector, absent/late/wrong alarm, unexpected actuator/power response, damage/intermittency or failed clear.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until connector identity, energy/coolant state, ESD/access procedure and recovery are approved.
Qualified operator and immediate human authorization are required for disconnect and separately for reseat.
Never pull conductors, bypass interlocks or substitute a software fault; preserve full evidence before reconnect.
Stop without retry on liquid, heat/arcing, damage, wrong signal, unexpected cooling action or uncertain restoration.
expected_evidence: Exact generic-HW row/variant/hash and signed connector/service map
Operator authorization, ESD and power/coolant/pump/valve baseline
Pre-disconnect connector/latch/pin photos and normal tray/BMC state
Timestamped one-time physical open and local diagnostic observation
Post-reseat inspection, deassertion, restored protection/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: For wrong identity, physical damage, unexpected actuator/power behavior or missing fault, stop and preserve the open-state evidence without improvising. Follow only the approved isolation/reseat procedure; leave the protection channel and node out of service if connector integrity or normal fault-clear state cannot be proven.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and criterion align; authoritative hardware identity, safe state and recovery are missing rather than contradictory.

blocked.reason: Static manual review is complete; execution awaits a supplyable service procedure and fault oracle.
